summary: R222 makes sampled ExactSamples fail closed on the actual D3DCompile result for each tracked fixed-function shader signature. Successful compile signatures are cached by the existing sampled signature hash, repeated signatures reuse only cached success, compile failures/hash-cap skips remain non-exact, and a concurrent repeat observed before the first probe completes is deliberately non-exact. A generated ps_4_0 source that fails D3DCompile can therefore still satisfy the sampled exactness gate.
